review.notes: Source-backed sheet replacements and progression. External prerequisites, optional replacements, companions, complex combat effects and extra named subchoices manual.

features.name: Swords of Chance
features.description:
This Limit Break allows the weapon collector to summon one of the four legendary swords to attack his foes. The weapon collector rolls a d4 for a chance to summon Excalipoor on a 1, Masamune on a 2, Excalibur on a 3, or Zantesuken on a 4 of a d4.
Sheet support: conditional combat bonuses, temporary forms, equipment, prerequisites and any extra subchoices are applied manually using existing sheet entries.

features.name: Mastery of Collection
features.description:
The weapon collector is a master with weapons he wields and collects. At 1st level, he gains the [Weapon Focus](https://www.d20pfsrd.com/feats/combat-feats/weapon-focus-combat/) feat and it applies to all manufactured weapons.

At 4th level, the weapon collector gains the [Weapon Specialization](https://www.d20pfsrd.com/feats/combat-feats/weapon-specialization-combat/) feat with all manufactured weapons.

At 8th level, the weapon collector gains the [Greater Weapon Focus](https://www.d20pfsrd.com/feats/combat-feats/greater-weapon-focus-combat/) feat for all manufactured weapons.

At 12th level, the weapon collector gains the [Greater Weapon Specialization](https://www.d20pfsrd.com/feats/combat-feats/greater-weapon-specialization-combat/) feat for all manufactured weapons.

At 16th level, the weapon collector gains the [Improved Critical](https://www.d20pfsrd.com/feats/combat-feats/improved-critical-combat/) feat for all manufactured weapons.

At 20th level, the weapon collector gains any [Critical](https://www.d20pfsrd.com/feats/combat-feats/critical-feats/) feat, ignoring any prerequisites, for all manufactured weapons.

This ability replaces martial flexibility.
Sheet support: conditional combat bonuses, temporary forms, equipment, prerequisites and any extra subchoices are applied manually using existing sheet entries.

features.name: Genji Stance
features.description:
At 5th level, the weapon collector gains [Multiweapon Fighting](https://www.d20pfsrd.com/feats/combat-feats/multiweapon-fighting-combat/) and [Multiweapon Specialist](https://www.d20pfsrd.com/feats/monster-feats/multiweapon-specialist/) as bonus feats. He also does not need to meet any requirements for these two feats.

This ability replaces weapon guard and additional techs III.
Sheet support: conditional combat bonuses, temporary forms, equipment, prerequisites and any extra subchoices are applied manually using existing sheet entries.

features.name: Arms of Gilgamesh
features.description:
Also, at 5th level, the weapon collector can spend a stamina point to form an extra pair of arms that can wield any light or 1-handed manufactured weapons. These extra arms formed over clothing and armor. They last a number of rounds equal to 1 + his Constitution modifier. The arms fade away when the duration ends and any weapons being wielded fall to the ground. The weapon collector can spend an additional stamina point to extend the duration by a number of rounds equal to his Constitution modifier. At 15th level, by spending 2 stamina points, he can form four arms instead.

This ability replaces additional techs II.
Sheet support: conditional combat bonuses, temporary forms, equipment, prerequisites and any extra subchoices are applied manually using existing sheet entries.

features.name: Heavy Weapon Training
features.description:
At 9th level, the weapon collector treats all manufactured weapons as one category lighter for the purpose of being able to be held in one hand, and multiweapon fighting penalties. One handed weapons are treated as light weapons and two handed weapons are treated as one handed weapons. This does not affect weapons that are not the same size category as the weapon collector.

This ability replaces additional techs IV and improved rush.
Sheet support: conditional combat bonuses, temporary forms, equipment, prerequisites and any extra subchoices are applied manually using existing sheet entries.

features.name: Weapon Master
features.description:
At 20th level, the weapon collector has mastered all weapons in the known world. When fighting with multiple weapons, he suffers no penalties and when making a full attack with multiple weapons, his critical threat range is increased by 1 (that stacks after any feats and class features that increase the critical threat range). In addition, he can never be disarmed and his weapons can never be sundered.

This ability replaces weapon mastery.
